title: ModBench: A Pipeline for Building Modelica Benchmark Datasets Mined from Library Repositories
abstract: arXiv:2608.16638v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Research on equation-based cyber-physical systems modeling languages, such as Modelica, is constrained by the lack of curated benchmark datasets. This limits empirical insight into the evolution and development of models. We address this gap with ModBench, a pipeline that mines Git repositories of Modelica libraries to produce benchmark datasets of model snapshots. The pipeline (1) filters repository commits to retain human-authored, Modelica-relevant revisions; (2) extracts simulation-eligible classes; and (3) builds canonical representations of Modelica classes. For empirical validation, we applied ModBench to the Modelica Standard Library (MSL) and report the resulting dataset, spanning the full commit history (since Modelica language v3), with 85,562 distinct class snapshots, and links enabling traceability to original models and Git metadata. translated_title: ModBench：一种从库仓库中挖掘构建Modelica基准数据集的流水线
translated_abstract: 摘要：基于方程的物理系统建模语言（如Modelica）的研究受限于缺乏精选的基准数据集。这限制了对模型演化和发展的实证洞察。我们通过ModBench解决了这一缺口，该流水线从Modelica库的Git仓库中挖掘数据，以生成模型快照的基准数据集。该流水线（1）过滤仓库提交，以保留人工编写且与Modelica相关的修订；（2）提取可进行模拟的类；（3）构建Modelica类的规范表示。为进行实证验证，我们将ModBench应用于Modelica标准库（MSL），并报告了所得数据集，该数据集覆盖了自Modelica语言v3以来的完整提交历史，包含85,562个不同的类快照，并提供链接以实现对原始模型和Git元数据的可追溯性。该数据集、其API及数据生成流水线均公开可用，以支持未来的研究。
tldr: ModBench提出了一种自动化流水线，从Modelica库的Git仓库中挖掘并构建包含85,562个类快照的基准数据集，覆盖完整提交历史，解决了该领域缺乏实证数据的问题。
en_tdlr: ModBench introduces an automated pipeline to mine Git repositories of Modelica libraries, generating a benchmark dataset of 85,562 class snapshots across the full commit history, addressing the lack of empirical data in this field.
